remarks: Prime location in Stamford! This pristine penthouse level unit is top notch. Enjoy the stunning views from your balcony! No floor above you! Upon entering this updated unit you will find that it is flooded with natural light. The oversized living room with separate dining area has hardwood floors. In this living space the view will be the showpiece. Great spot for your office, too. The kitchen with gas range has lots of counter and cabinet space; the tile backsplash and window view add a wow factor. The balcony is large enough for a bistro set, plus lounge chairs and table and is a great space to take in the majestic distant views. The expansive primary bedroom offers double closets, hardwood flooring and plenty of room for a king size bed and large furniture. The updated bathroom with stunning accent wall and floor tile has a full bath with an oversized tub. Lots of closet space for storage. The complex offers a pool, fitness room, shared laundry room in the basement, is gated with security guard and has an assigned outdoor parking space. HOA includes heat, hot water, water, sewer, trash, the parking space and use of all the amenities. This is by far one of the nicest units in the complex with it's exposure to natural light, peaceful view and penthouse-top floor location. This comfortable/cozy home is located in a highly desired area. Bus stop for the Metro-North train is right near the building. Please do not let the friendly cat out.
